name: explorer-shell
goal: Every Harness explorer route shares one horizontal navbar: the gold mark, the Harness name and the repository, five categories (Pages, Components, Functions, Configs, Services) with an outline icon above each label and a gold underline on the active one, and on the right the branch with its tip hash, the viewed commit with whether it is the tip, and Go to tip, all through the shared Select; a shared icon set, a binary verification badge and scoped explorer styles are reused by the entity screens, and the page never overflows sideways on desktop, tablet or phone

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Scope from Daniel's approved designs (harness-entity-designs-v10: navbar.json, navbar-reference.png and mockups 01, 06, 19, 24, 25) and the shell brief: one bar for every explorer route with the gold mark, the Harness name and the repository, five categories with an icon above each label and a gold line under the active one, branch and commit through the shared Select with separate tip and viewed labels and Go to tip; a shared icon set, a binary verification badge, an outlined action, tabs and scoped tokens for the entity screens; no Reports, Analytics, Activity or Growth in the bar; legacy calls of HarnessHeader, HarnessSelectors and HarnessTabs keep working; no horizontal overflow at 1440, 920 and 390 pixels. Acceptance criteria and proof are in specification/features/planned/explorer-shell.md. The input of the bar is data's ExplorerScope and ExplorerLocation with the host's href and onroute, as Codex decided in shell-steering.md; the public API is in shell-status.md. Out of scope and left to integration: wiring in HarnessConsole, the unit index, budgets, the whole build and bun run check.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: New in packages/reports: components/harness/HarnessNavbar.svelte (the bar; composes HarnessSelectors), HarnessIcon.svelte (40 icons from utils/harnessIcons.ts), HarnessVerdict.svelte (binary badge: green only for passed === true), HarnessAction.svelte (link, button or disabled button); utils/harnessShell.ts (pure view model of the bar, plainClick, the input and tab types); lib/styles/explorer.css, explorer-navbar.css, explorer-controls.css (tokens on .hx-shell, every rule under an hx- class, each file under 220 lines), imported from harness.css so console.ts and the route page did not change. Extended compatibly: HarnessHeader takes an optional navbar and then draws the bar in place of the title row and its links; HarnessSelectors takes an optional tip for the labels, the short hash over the closed commit field and Go to tip; HarnessTabs takes an optional list and label and is generic over the view id. Select.svelte, HarnessShell.svelte and console.ts are unchanged. Unit manifests for the 11 new units and the 4 touched ones are in specification/units with declared responsibilities and are byte-equal to what units index derives in an isolated copy of the tree; the shared index was not written. harness explain list shows all 19 changes of these units explained. svelte-check reports no error in any of these files, harness audit of the app reports none of them, eslint and prettier pass on them.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
Declare the scenario states of the shell and wire its two browser checks into verification.
steps.evidence: specification/scenarios/explorer-shell.json declares five required states (current, historical, returned, pieces, pieces-used) at desktop 1440x1000, tablet 920x800 and mobile 390x844 with required screenshot evidence from the declared build shell-fixture; harness scenarios check passes (6 scenarios) and harness scenarios show explorer-shell lists the 15 captures. Announced in shell-status.md before editing, as shell-steering.md allowed: packages/reports/package.json gained build:shell and test:shell and no existing script changed; harness.verify.json gained one setup command (bun run --cwd packages/reports build:shell), the build shell-fixture at packages/reports/output/shell-fixture and two checks that run explorer-shell.spec.ts and explorer-shell-pieces.spec.ts with src/config/shellPlaywrightConfig.ts; hashes before and after are in work/explorer-shell/shared-files-before.sha256 and shared-files-after.sha256. Simulated as a verification runs it, without committing or running harness verify: bun run --cwd packages/reports build:shell, then each check with HARNESS_VERIFY=1, HARNESS_VERIFY_REVISION, TAKE_SCREENSHOT=1 and an evidence directory of its own: 9 passed and 6 passed, the fixture served as setup compiled it and not rebuilt, 15 captures written. Judged with Harness's own BuildIdentityService.declared, gatherCaptures and scenarioCoverage: no gather failure, no coverage failure, every state passed at three viewports, each stamp the identity harness verify identity prints for the directory; judged against another commit the same captures are rejected as produced by another revision; outside a verification a capture names the placeholder revision and claims no commit. Not run: harness verify on a commit, which needs the whole build and belongs to integration.

steps.title: Keep the tab that is shown whole in its strip when the selection or the width changes.
steps.evidence: HarnessTabs.svelte binds its tablist and reveal() moves scrollLeft of the strip alone by the measured overhang of the selected tab, on a change of view or tabs and on a ResizeObserver of the strip; no prop changed, the page is not scrolled, nothing is focused. Fixture: tests/e2e/support/shell/ShellPrimitives.svelte gained a 230 px strip and three buttons that choose a tab from outside the strip. RED on the unchanged component (sha256 718eb9f7...): bun x playwright test --config src/config/shellPlaywrightConfig.ts explorer-shell-pieces, the new test 'the tab that is shown stays whole in its strip, however it was chosen' 3 failed at whole(narrow) (work/explorer-shell/pass4/tabs-browser-RED.log). GREEN: 9 passed at 1440, 920 and 390 px: the strip scrolls, History is whole on open, after Show contract and Show history, the keyboard walks from History to Measurements with Shift+Tab, and after a 1440 px window becomes the screen of the test both strips keep History whole and the page is no wider than the screen. Negative proof of the resize half in a throwaway copy with only the ResizeObserver effect removed: mobile failed, desktop and tablet passed (pass4/tabs-resize-NEGATIVE.log). redgreen.sh both, same 23 files by sha256: red on a pristine export of b4afb74 24 browser failed and 9 unit files failed; green 43 unit passed and 24 browser passed. Real entity screen, scratch spec run in a throwaway copy of the package against the entity preview (pass4/entity-tabs-check.sh, entity-tabs.log): Orders page History opened at 1440 px then resized: mobile strip clientWidth 358, scrollWidth 401, scrollLeft 43, History whole, page fits; tablet and desktop need no scroll; 3 passed. Screenshots inspected: output/evidence/current/explorer-shell-tabs-{desktop,tablet,mobile}.png and pass4/entity-tabs/entity-history-mobile.png show History whole with its gold line and the first tab cut at the left edge of the strip on the phone. Scenario state pieces-tabs declared in specification/scenarios/explorer-shell.json; harness scenarios check passes; in the isolated copy built at 01:10 the three checks run as a verification runs them wrote 21 stamped captures, 7 states at 3 viewports, judged passed with no gather or coverage failure (pass4/isolated-shell-verify.log).
